# Test font fixtures

Latin-subset TTF snippets used only by `test/sfntMeta.test.ts`.

| File | Upstream family | License |
|------|-----------------|---------|
| `silkscreen-latin.ttf` | [Silkscreen](https://github.com/googlefonts/silkscreen) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `tinos-latin.ttf` | [Tinos](https://github.com/googlefonts/tinos) (Liberation / STIX lineage distributed by Google Fonts) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `cousine-latin.ttf` | [Cousine](https://github.com/googlefonts/cousine) (Liberation Mono lineage) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

Each file is an ASCII Latin subset of the OFL original from the [google/fonts](https://github.com/google/fonts) tree (`ofl/silkscreen`, `ofl/tinos`, `ofl/cousine`). Redistribution of modified versions under the OFL is permitted; see `OFL.txt`.

These subsets shrink glyph coverage for repo size — they are not complete fonts for design use.
